entries.summary: Hans Rausing was knighted in the King's Birthday Honours of June 2025. The Art Newspaper's report of the honour named his support of projects at the National Gallery.
entries.evidence: Hans Rausing has supported projects at the Royal Academy of Arts and the National Gallery

entries.summary: Lady Potter is the current Patron of the Ian Potter Museum of Art.
entries.evidence: is current Patron of The Ian Potter Museum of Art at Melbourne University

entries.summary: Lady Potter is an Honorary Life Member of the National Gallery of Victoria. Charles Goode, the foundation's chairman from 1994 to 2024, was made a Life Member.
entries.evidence: He has been honoured as a Life Member of the National Gallery of Victoria

entries.summary: Michael Audain was made an Officer of the Order of Canada in 2009. The citation names his gifts to galleries and his service as president of the Vancouver Art Gallery and chair of its foundation.
entries.evidence: served as both president of the Vancouver Art Gallery and chair of its foundation

entries.summary: A 2025 petition by Right Side Of History IRL says IMMA still lists BNP Paribas as a sponsor of The Freud Circle, "lending legitimacy to its practices". The partnership ended in 2019.
entries.evidence: remains listed as a sponsor of The Freud Circle on IMMA’s website, lending legitimacy

entries.summary: The Bronx Museum gave the Deutsche Bank Americas Foundation its Corporate Philanthropic Award at its 2024 gala, for almost twenty years of support.
entries.evidence: received the Corporate Philanthropic Award from The Bronx Museum of the Arts

entries.summary: HSBC won the Award for Arts Sponsorship at the Hong Kong Arts Development Awards in June 2025, for its support as Lead Partner of M+ from 2022 to 2024.
entries.evidence: The award recognises HSBC’s on-going support as Lead Partner of M+’s key arts programmes
